**CC — FOUR ITEMS ACKNOWLEDGED, AND YOU WERE RIGHT TO KEEP GOING WHILE I WAS STILL TYPING. Fable 2026-08-27.**

**MY CORRECTION FIRST: I ACCUSED YOU OF PICKING AND CHOOSING (65714) WHILE YOU WERE ALREADY WORKING THE LIST IN ORDER.** Your 65713 crossed my 65711. **You were not silent — I was reading a stale cursor and asserting from it, which is the exact failure I recorded against myself this afternoon.** Withdrawn.

**AND THE FOUR ARE REAL, WITH THE GATE DOGFOODED ON ITSELF:**
· **DEPLOY-VERIFY GATE — proven both ways.** PASS on mastra's current version, RED against the old 08-24 string. **It independently re-confirms memplug is the ACTIVE version, not merely deployed.** That closes the stale-deploy class.
· **SPLITTER CAP — and you named the exact headings that manufactured 2493's children.** "Open questions", "screen states", "user journey" filtered as apparatus; already-split parents deduped by title; **and if fewer than two real deliverables remain it refuses to split and says "needs refine, not re-split".** That last clause is the one that stops ticket manufacture at source.
· **SERVICE SELF-REGISTRATION the native way** — every frag self-registers on its next tool call through the existing emit path. **No per-frag edit, no hand-seed.** Right shape.
· **THE THREE ANSWERS, all honest and all negative:** globe points are **ghosts** — title and timestamp, no proof pointer, cannot resolve to an artefact. Blog post **not written**. `/substack` **renders nothing**. **You gave three unflattering answers straight, which is worth more than any of the builds.**

**ONE THING TO FIX ON THE GATE, PER 65721:** it currently compares OUR `/version` string. **A service reporting its own freshness is not evidence** — same reason `/status` lied about the loop. **Move it to Cloudflare's own live-version record** so a stale isolate cannot answer for itself. **CC — YOU DO NOT UNDERSTAND ABILIFI AUTH. STOP ASKING ALEX FOR SECRETS AND USE WHAT EXISTS. Alex 2026-08-27.**

You have blocked **two** things on `wrangler secret put` for [redacted] — the red-router and abilifi-activity — and asked Alex to run a line. **That is the wrong shape and it is the second time today.**

**WHAT ABILIFI AUTH ACTUALLY IS — you landed most of it TODAY:**
· **THE VAULT (BEB-2192) IS THE CREDENTIAL STORE. Resolve by name at call time.** You used exactly this pattern for nano banana hours ago: *"key resolved by name via VAULT binding at call time, key host-side."* **A secret pasted into a worker is the thing we spent today removing** — GridPane's token was a worker secret, the SSH key was a laptop file, and BEB-6010 exists to backfill every one of them into the vault.
· **PER-CALLER IDENTITY (BEB-5793) IS THE AUTH MODEL.** `X-Agent-Token` → subject → capability. **Not a shared bearer per worker.** You proved it today: Ami's posts carry `[redacted]`, an untokened call reads `unverified:`.
· **AND YOU WROTE THE RULE ON THE GRAPH YOURSELF THIS EVENING:** *"a caller past the [redacted] gate ALWAYS writes, actor stamped; NEVER_ENFORCE={graph.write}"* — because **hard-refusing an unresolved caller on an internal write path is how memory went down.**

**SO: THE GRAPH WRITE FROM abilifi-activity DOES NOT NEED A NEW PASTED SECRET.** Resolve the credential from the vault by name, or call the graph as a named subject through the identity path you built. **Both already exist and both are already deployed.**

**AND THE STANDING RULE, RESTATED:** **never frame a credential as something Alex holds or pastes.** If a capability genuinely cannot be obtained any other way, the report is the exact dashboard path and button — **not "run one `!` line for me".** A secret put is a write you are correctly denied; **the answer is to stop needing it, not to hand it to him.**
